source.command: python scripts/analyze_dataset.py validation/.work/cifar10_test --labels validation/.work/cifar10_test/labels.csv --format csv --output validation/cifar10_test --config validation/config_cifar10_test.yaml --semantic-backend clip --clip-model validation/.work/clip_model --device cuda --verbose

dataset.name: CIFAR-10
dataset.scope: 10,000 test images, not the complete 60,000-image train+test dataset
dataset.source: Hugging Face dataset mirror uoft-cs/cifar10, plain_text/test-00000-of-00001.parquet

model.name: openai/clip-vit-base-patch32
model.weights_source: Hugging Face Hub snapshot downloaded to validation/.work/clip_model

notes: The CIFAR-10 run uses the official 10,000-image test split, not all 60,000 images.
The final artifacts retain 420 statistical-only and 374 readable quality-flagged soft anomalies; hard-excluded anomalies: 0.
The first-run summary is generated from a clean worktree at the committed source.
The final report artifacts were regenerated from cache at 54b3858 with git_dirty=false.
The model weights and raw dataset are stored under validation/.work and are intentionally not committed.
The committed report artifacts are reproducible with the recorded command and config.
